values.note: $10 a night, water and electricity included. Pay in advance at the Village Office (326 Ogden Avenue, Mon-Fri 9-4) or in the drop box. An after-hours electric hookup costs $20 extra (call 308-824-3681).

fees.source: https://villageofoxfordne.com/rv-park ('Camping Fee is $10.00 per night.', 'There will be an additional $20 charge for after hours hook-up.', 'Water and electricity are included.'), read 2026-11-05 on the village's current site

note: Village of Oxford park (Furnas County): RV hookups in the shaded grass at George Mitchell Park, by the ball field and the stocked fishing pond. Sewer dump station provided; don't run gray water onto the grass. The RV park is reserved each June for the Turkey Days carnival, with a few spaces left first come. Disc golf on the grounds. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $10 (+$20 after-hours hookup), first come, 14-day limit, 10 hookups with water (village page, now manual). Electric changes 50 -> 30 A: the only amperage sources are Campendium/The Dyrt (20/30 A); the 50 A came from unsourced note prose. Turkey Days June blocking added to the note. Pin ~125 m (on the ball field).
flags: HOOKUPS changed: electric 50 -> 30 (reported). The village page gives no amperage, and the 2026-09 '20/30/50-amp, varies by site' came from note prose without a source. Campendium lists 30 and 20 amp and The Dyrt says '30 amp and water hook-ups' (search summary; reviews 2017-2022). A 50-amp pedestal may exist; nothing I read shows one.

UNSOURCED stored values: facilities.laundry true and season.year_round true come from 2026-09 note prose; the village page mentions neither. Left unchanged (derived), but unverified. The village page names no laundry; a town laundromat may be what the old note meant.

TURKEY DAYS: 'The RV Park is reserved annually in June for the carnival which provides entertainment for "Turkey Days." ... There will be a limited number of spaces that will be available to the public during Turkey Days, as a first come first serve basis.' Now in the note.

RATE DATE: '$10.00 per night' is undated text on the village's live site (current 2026 banner). Reviews are old (Campendium/The Dyrt 2017-2022, some calling the first night free; RV Life 1 rating from 2011), so there is no dated camper report.

PIN (small move): stored 40.24700,-99.63600 is on the ball-field infield. Google's 'George Mitchell RV Park' point 40.2469,-99.6375 (~125 m W) sits in the shaded grass with a gravel loop and small white posts that look like pedestals. Suggest 40.2469,-99.6375.
PHONE 308-824-3511 (village office) stays: Campendium lists it, and the page names the Village Office. The page's after-hours line is 308-824-3681.
